mid_game_rebalance_2026_07_20.jagex_quote_summary: Rather than directly increasing XP rates, these changes focus on making energy gathering feel more consistent. Target ~70% success when first unlocking a new energy type. Average success-rate increases across each energy type's level band.
mid_game_rebalance_2026_07_20.planner_impact: Do not claim Jagex published post-midgame wisp XP/h numbers. Expect a modest XP/h uplift vs pre-midgame baselines from higher gather success, largest near each tier unlock.
